claims: FPCON Charlie is the second-highest Force Protection Condition.
FPCON Charlie is triggered when intelligence indicates that terrorist action against personnel or facilities is likely.
FPCON Charlie is triggered when a suspicious incident occurs.
FPCON Charlie requires potential gate closures.
FPCON Charlie requires heightened alertness to protect against or respond to a probable threat.
FPCON Charlie security measures include 100% ID checks.
FPCON Charlie security measures include 100% vehicle inspections.
FPCON Charlie security measures include increased armed patrols.
FPCON Charlie security measures include potential closure of non-essential gates.
FPCON Charlie is one step below FPCON Delta.
FPCON Delta is for when an attack has occurred or is imminent.
